hooks.command: TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y-%m-%d_%H%M") && DEST="$(ls -d "$HOME"/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-*/"My Drive"/CLAUDE_AI/APP_LESNOTESDEPATATE/APP/backups | head -1)" && [ -d "$DEST" ] && rsync -a --exclude='node_modules' --exclude='.expo' --exclude='ios/build' --exclude='ios/Pods' --exclude='.git' --exclude='dist' --exclude='flow-captures' --exclude='flow-diagram*' --exclude='flow.html' --exclude='flow.mmd' --exclude='graphify-out' --exclude='static_analysis_semgrep_1' "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/" "${DEST}/backup_${TIMESTAMP}/" 2>/dev/null || true && find "${DEST}" -maxdepth 1 -name 'backup_*' -type d | sort -r | tail -n +6 | while IFS= read -r old; do rm -rf "$old"; done 2>/dev/null || true
